description: Sequencer running an eight-bit linear feedback shift register, with a gate output for every register bit and four CV outputs summed from weighted bits, superseded by LFSR8 Poly

params.text: Switches one feedback coefficient on or off; the register bits whose coefficient is on are combined to make the bit shifted in
Feeds the inverse of the combined bit back into the register, making it an XNOR register rather than an XOR one
Sets how many of the eight register bits are used, 1 to 8
Sets one of the four weights the CV outputs are summed from, 0 to 1; every set register bit adds one of the four weights, and each CV output starts the rotation of weights at a different knob

inputs.text: A rising edge shifts the register one place, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A voltage above 0V switches that feedback coefficient on and a lower one switches it off, and the button for it moves with the voltage
A voltage above 0V makes the register feed back the inverted bit, and moves the not button with it

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that register bit is set and the clock is high, and 0V otherwise
A voltage summed from the set register bits, each weighted by one of the four V/OCT knobs, reaching 8V with every bit set and every weight at maximum

notes: the round lights give the register bits, bright for a set bit and dim for a clear one
the register is shifted only by a rising edge at CLK; with nothing patched there the outputs never change
every feedback coefficient starts switched off, so the register shifts in zeros and falls silent within a few clocks; switch at least one coefficient on for a repeating sequence
the maker marks this module deprecated and points to LFSR8 Poly instead, so it is left out of the module browser unless the browser is set to show deprecated modules
